turns.assessment: The simultaneous loss of a very large set of services whose working paths all transit S08, across many optical degrees and channels, points to a common ODU-layer failure at S08. Optical powers, OSNR, BER, DGD, amplifier telemetry, and direct services terminating at S08 remained normal, strongly excluding line, amplifier, span, and ROADM optical faults. The pattern is characteristic of the S08 OTN switch fabric failing and interrupting every ODU cross-connected through it.

proposals.rationale: E1 (otn.S08) is common to every affected working path. A switch-fabric failure explains the simultaneous interruption of many unrelated ODUs while optical-layer telemetry remains unchanged and services terminating at S08 can remain operational.

The S08 ROADM is also shared, but a documented WSS input-port failure would affect only channels arriving on one degree and should produce optical signal-loss evidence. The affected services use many degrees and the optical instruments saw no change.
